hero.name: Diego Olalla
hero.lead: Software Engineering student at FIAP, learning back-end with Python, FastAPI and Django.

about.photoAlt: Diego wearing glasses and a black T-shirt, resting his head on his hand
about.p1: I study Software Engineering and the back-end is the part I like most, the side behind the screen: APIs, business rules and data.
about.p2: I currently work as a freelancer building landing pages, and soon I'll move on to more complex systems. My focus is Python: I'm studying FastAPI and Django, and later on I'll learn Java and Spring Boot to broaden my knowledge. I learn best by building projects, and their code is here.

projects.intro: Study and freelance projects, with what makes each one interesting.

p1.title: Sito's Estacionamento
p1.desc: A marketing landing page I built as a freelancer for a parking business with two locations in Méier, Rio de Janeiro. It shows each location's prices, maps with a 360° tour and an "Open now" status calculated in São Paulo's time zone.
p1.learned: Local SEO with JSON-LD, isolated JS modules with import(), a lite mode that turns off heavy effects on slow machines, and cache busting with versioned URLs.

p3.title: This portfolio
p3.desc: Built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no framework, with three.js for the 3D envelope in the contact section. It comes in Portuguese and English, has a light and a dark theme, and an animated topographic map at the top that reacts to the mouse.
p3.learned: IntersectionObserver, fetching JSON, custom events, Canvas and accessibility.

wip.title: Next project: a FastAPI API
wip.desc: I'm studying to build my first REST API with FastAPI and a database. Follow along on GitHub.

p4.title: $ents
p4.desc: A personal finance app I'm building with friends. It shows how much of your salary is already committed to subscriptions and installments, which makes money talk more honest between couples and housemates.

p5.title: ALERA
p5.desc: An alert system for people living in Juiz de Fora's 142 risk areas. The back-end already runs with the risk areas registered and raises alerts based on Civil Defense warnings. Future plans: a Python script that sends the alerts on WhatsApp, with the street name. Built as a team (MonkeyNerds).

journey.intro: How I got here, in order.

i1.title: The start
i1.desc: I took one semester of Computer Science and fell in love with logic and with building projects in languages like Java and Python.

i2.title: Software Engineering
i2.desc: I now study Software Engineering at FIAP, focusing on back-end development.

i3.title: Data Structures and Algorithms
i3.desc: I'm taking data structures and algorithms courses to get a more solid base and write more efficient code.

i4.title: Freelance landing pages
i4.desc: I build landing pages for clients as a freelancer, and soon I'll move on to more complex systems.

next.title: Junior back-end role
next.desc: I want to join a team where I can learn from more experienced people and help on the back-end with Python, FastAPI and Django.

contact.text: I'm looking for my first junior role, and I'm always up for talking about back-end.
